text: {"rulings": [{"id": "1", "relation": "refines", "reason": "Marcus's sign-off adds who approved the SQLite choice; it does not change the fact that the database is SQLite."}, {"id": "2", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Marcus approving SQLite and Joy no longer running a separate database server are both true at once; the sign-off says nothing about Joy's server setup."}, {"id": "3", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Approving SQLite as the database engine says nothing about whether the schema is settled; both can hold."}, {"id": "4", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Marcus pushing the launch date in May is a separate past event from his signing off on SQLite in July."}, {"id": "5", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Marcus wanting the customs module in scope is a scope preference unaffected by his approval of SQLite."}]}
